force_generation.calibration_mean: 1 + tau * z, with three independent z ~ Uniform(-sqrt(3),sqrt(3))
force_generation.strain_seed: legacy generate_dataset calibrated regime default_rng(seed); paired across shape/tau/method
force_generation.interpretation: tau is the exact standard deviation of independent external load-measurement error; Gaussian penalty is a variance-weighted working objective, not a claimed posterior

regularization.selection: largest successful lambda with whitened data-plus-calibration norm <= 1.2*sqrt(N+M); otherwise smallest successful norm and mark incompatible; M=3 for finite positive prior, otherwise M=0

reporting: paired medians and quartiles; six primary replicates and four resolution replicates, not independent physical specimens; retain all starts and failed candidates
continuum: Separate independently verified model and intact-only calibration protocol to be frozen after numerical development, before defect inversion.
